name: Jinguji Kanade
source:
The heir of the Shinguji Group, one of the top conglomerates in Japan.
A talented and prideful girl that always dreamed of becoming a transforming heroine.
She joins with Miya, a heroine from the future, and forms AntiDomi.
It seems she fits the transformation suit even better than Miya...
